critical_2_spring_bean_cycle_structurall.evidence: Task 4 elevates FunnelExecutionFactory from 'preferred fix' to a hard requirement. The bean-graph startup check is an explicit Verification step in Task 4 ('assert that FunnelEventService does NOT inject FunnelTriggerServiceImpl at all... and that FunnelExecutionFactory has NO dependency on FunnelExecutionEngine/StepExecutor'). Task 5 closes the edge and carries a mandatory @SpringBootTest context-load AC: 'The application context starts without BeanCurrentlyInCreationException after wiring FunnelEventService into StepExecutor — proven by a @SpringBootTest context-load assertion.' TDD Anchor has FunnelTriggerContextIT::contextStarts_afterFunnelEventServiceWiredIntoStepExecutor.
